LanguageData.MF_TreeManageDesc: Choose and pin photographs, or filter the kinds of photos added automatically.
LanguageData.MF_Tree_AutoFillTip: New photos fill empty branches. When full, the oldest unpinned photo is replaced.
LanguageData.MF_Tree_FilterTip: Choose which kinds are added automatically. Manually pinned photos stay in place.
LanguageData.MF_Tree_NoPhotos: Choose a photograph from the album for this branch.
LanguageData.MF_Tree_RemoveTip: Removes it from this tree. The original remains in the album.
LanguageData.MF_Tree_FullPinned: Every photo is pinned. Unpin one to make room for new photos.
LanguageData.MF_Tree_Policy: Choosing a photo pins it. Automatic photos change as new photos arrive.
